content:
sarah: Heads-up: company-wide privileged access review + new enforcement timelines. We found several high-privilege tokens (API tokens, service user sessions, admin console tokens) that do not have MFA enforced or are older than 180 days. This thread lists required actions and deadlines. Please read and ack if you own any admin consoles or automation owning 'admin' scope.

audit-bot: Automated audit summary: 47 tokens detected without MFA binding, 12 active admin sessions older than 90 days, 8 integrations using long-lived admin API tokens. Details and per-owner list posted to secure ticket RW-Sec-1042.

tom: Ack. What's the enforcement timeline and the exact policy change?

sarah: TL;DR: policy change will require MFA-bound sessions for any token with admin privileges, and we will sunset long-lived admin API tokens. Deadlines: 2026-04-12 - owners must either (1) bind tokens to MFA device via token vault, (2) rotate to short-lived tokens (<24h), or (3) migrate to scoped service roles without admin scope. On 2026-04-15 we'll start auto-revocation for non-compliant tokens.

linda: I manage the internal admin dashboard. We'll need a migration path for automation that posts incidents to PagerDuty and uses admin APIs. Can we get a recommended pattern?

sarah: Recommended patterns: use the token vault with ephemeral sessions (HashiCorp Vault / internal token service) or service principals scoped to minimum privileges with workload identity. Avoid admin-scoped tokens where possible. We'll publish a short migration guide in infra docs.

dirk: Any exceptions process? Some legacy on-call runbooks still use static admin tokens.

sarah: Exceptions are possible but require an approval ticket with a mitigation plan and expiry (max 90 days). Request via RW-Sec-EXCEPT and include owner, reason, and migration timeline. We expect very few exceptions.

security-ops: Office hours & support: we'll host two sessions this week to help teams migrate (2026-04-02 15:00 UTC and 2026-04-03 09:00 UTC). Also open 1:1 slots for critical automation. Link: https://tinyurl.com/rw-priv-access-offhours

audit-bot: Helpful checks and commands (examples):
- List active OAuth tokens in Okta (example): okta-admin list-sessions --filter "created gt '2026-01-01'"
- Query Secrets Manager for secrets with admin scope tags: secretsctl query --tag admin --age-gt 180d
- Identify GitHub tokens with org:admin scope via token-scanner (internal)

linda: owner: admin-dashboard - action: plan-migration - notes: will replace admin token with role-limited service account using token vault by 2026-04-10.

tom: owner: infra-alerts - action: rotated - notes: rotated PagerDuty webhook to ephemeral token via vault, verified alert delivery.

sarah: A couple of gotchas we found: (1) some monitoring webhooks store tokens in plaintext in older runbooks, (2) CI runners sometimes cache tokens in runner images. Please search history and CI images. We'll add a scanning rule for TODO.

dirk: owner: legacy-runbooks - action: exception-requested - notes: three runbooks require manual intervention by oncall team, filing RW-Sec-EXCEPT-21 with timeline to retire in 45 days.

security-ops: We will also enable an org-wide policy to block creation of new admin-scoped tokens without an approval tag starting 2026-04-05. This will prevent new technical debt.

oncall-bot: Maintenance note: policy rollout will be staggered by service tier. We'll notify affected owners directly.

sarah: Please post final status lines in this thread when you complete work: `owner: service - token_type: api/oauth/admin - action: rotated/migrated/exception - expiry: date or n/a - notes`

linda: owner: admin-dashboard - token_type: api - action: migrated - expiry: 2026-04-20 - notes: moved to token vault, bound to MFA, canaries pass.

tom: owner: metrics-pipeline - token_type: oauth - action: rotated - expiry: 2026-04-15 - notes: replaced with scoped service account, CI updated.

dirk: owner: oncall-runbooks - token_type: api - action: exception - expiry: 2026-05-17 - notes: exception approved with mitigation; plan to remove by expiry.

sarah: Post-action items: (1) we'll add a CI pre-commit lint to detect admin-scoped tokens in code, (2) add monitoring alert for admin tokens older than 30 days, (3) require MFA enforcement in SSO for admin groups.

security-ops: Policy change summary to be published to Staff and Engineering: MFA binding required for admin tokens; long-lived admin tokens deprecated; exception process described. Will follow with email and Confluence doc.

audit-bot: Final reminder: token auto-revocation will begin 2026-04-15 00:00 UTC. Tokens not flagged as migrated or under exception will be revoked.

sarah: Thanks all for quick triage. If you own any tooling that we did not identify, please check and post status here. We'll run a final audit sweep on 2026-04-14 and close the ticket if clean. :lock:
